head: indented hex with conical washer, E headmark
notes: Zip kit lists GM 3858700 AND 3847962 together, so the size can't be tied to 3858700 alone. Corvette Pacifica/EC Products sell 3858700 as battery hold-down bolt w/ washer and front sway bar bracket bolt (E headmark) without size. camaros.net list '3858700-P229 3863392-P53 10-16X3/4' - that size belongs to 3863392, not used.
